items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Now Eldridge, I thought he was terrific.

ctx.x: But I mean there's many different styles. I mean Louis, which style do you like?

Well Louis, to me, he had the best style. Now Eldridge, I thought he was terrific. I didn't hear Eldridge on too many records, but After You're Gone, Eldridge made a terrific record on After You're Gone. I even heard James on one or two records and it sounded pretty jazzy to me. He had a different style when he was with, what you call his band, Goodman's band. I didn't like that style too much, but it made him. But on a record I have with him and Coleman Hawkins I believe, he sounded pretty good.
But back to Armstrong, what tunes do you like that Louis made?
